payload.title: File:Frog-n-Roll.jpg
payload.description_html: The bird Indochinese Roller Coracias affinis, also known as Neelkanth in Hindi, is a State bird of many Indian States. Here this bird grabbed a frog around its home at Kaziranga National Park (Assam) and displayed the catch for a while before flying off to privacy.
